    • Century19thSkin

      public Century19thSkin(float radius, org.jogamp.vecmath.Color3f color)
      Sets up customizations for this onionskin and delegates everything else to its parent class.
      Parameters:
      radius - in meters of the onionskin (adjusted for viewing distance), therefore value has almost no meaning at all. I just try different values until things are about the right size.
      color - of onionskin and associated links and nodes.
